method: Opt-in primitive owner spans. Timing counter reads add overhead; CPU/wall windows differ slightly in the first diagnostic. GC MXBean counter deltas alone do not prove stop-the-world overlap. Only JFR GCPhasePause and paired SafepointBegin/End provide overlap attribution; raw JFR stays under target. Monotonic/epoch clock anchors interpolate host clock offset. No recorded media or frame-performance claim.
